The main takeaway from our work is that

the analytical models used for the prediction of the neutrino flux are not sufficiently accurate to draw firm conclusions on the physics of gamma-ray bursts from neutrino observations, and that a more detailed numerical calculation is needed.
the analytical fireball model is a useful tool for estimating the neutrino flux, but it needs to be carefully calibrated with numerical computations.
